sources_considered.why: The October 11 version surveys both standalone and retrieval-augmented LLMs and describes remaining limitations.
Read to verify the original version and publication date.
FreshLLMs documents factuality problems and improvements, but its experiments do not describe the selected October observation window.
Reading the methods and captions established that its models were benchmarked on April 26, 2023. Publication in October does not turn those measurements into October results.
A later factuality survey surfaced in search; it was not used to establish the October 2023 research position.

evidence_items.explanation: The contemporary survey considers factuality evaluation and enhancement for standalone and retrieval-augmented models, and describes fully factual LLMs as an outstanding research goal. This supports the ordinary research-state reading, although it does not prove a universal impossibility.

unresolved_gaps: A literature search cannot prove that no unpublished or narrowly constrained guarantee existed.
The source establishes an unresolved general research problem, not a mathematical impossibility theorem.
